text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the spring Tenno Sho. T.M. Opera O, with otherworldly presence, declares the beginning of a new chapter to the fierce competition there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega has no intentions of getting involved in the theatrics, but she won't give up the starring role either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads off, ready to go against T.M. Opera O and Narita Top Road in this spring showdown.
